title: SkVoid
description: SkVoid is a lightweight Skript addon focused on advanced session management. It allows developers to easily track, manage, and reward player activity through real-time session data and custom playtime statistics.
body:
🚀 SkVoid - Advanced Skript Addon
📋 Overview

SkVoid is a powerful Skript addon for Minecraft 1.21.x that extends Skript capabilities with advanced features like NBT manipulation, particle animations, webhooks, and real-time UI management.

✨ Key Features

30+ Manager Systems: Modular architecture with specialized managers
Advanced NBT: Custom items, attributes, enchantments beyond vanilla limits
Particle Animations: 20+ shapes with dynamic animation systems
Webhook Integration: Discord and HTTP webhook support
Real-time UI: Auto-updating tabs, bossbars, and scoreboards
Built-in Placeholders: 50+ placeholders without external dependencies
Performance Optimized: Async processing, caching, memory management

🎮 Skript Elements
25+ Effects: Particle systems, UI management, NBT operations
15+ Expressions: Data manipulation and utility functions
10+ Conditions: Flexible condition checking

🔧 Technical Details
Java 21: Modern performance optimizations
Cross-Version: Compatible with Paper, Purpur, Spigot
Configuration: Comprehensive config system with validation
API Access: Full developer API for custom implementations
